commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
git status --short --branch
if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/develop HEAD; then
  git merge --no-ff origin/develop -m 'Reconcile develop product work into main line'
fi
echo '=== CANDIDATE ==='
git log -1 --oneline --decorate
printf 'contains develop: ' && git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/develop HEAD && echo yes
printf 'contains main: ' && git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD && echo yes
git push origin HEAD:work/reconcile-main-develop
